name: Nihonbashi

en.name: Nihonbashi
en.description: Tokyo's historic commercial zero-mile marker and financial district, famous for centuries-old department stores and traditional artisan shops. The iconic stone bridge has served as Japan's road network origin since 1603.
en.notes: Explore local specialty food stalls and boutique shops at a relaxed pace.
en.reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
en.parking: Commercial district paid parking garages available nearby.

ja.name: 日本橋
ja.description: 五街道の起点として日本の道路網の中心を担ってきた歴史と伝統の商業街です。老舗の和菓子店や百貨店、重厚な石造りの日本橋が独特の風情を醸し出しています。
ja.reservation: 事前予約不要。現地にてチケットをご購入いただくか、自由にご見学いただけます。
ja.parking: 周辺の有料駐車場または公共駐車場をご利用いただけます。
